# Instructions for Copilot

Sandpiper is a small tool that syncs bookmarks between browsers. It is plain Python 3.11
with `pip` and a virtualenv; dependencies are in `requirements.txt` and
`requirements-dev.txt`.

Use "python -m pytest", not bare "pytest", so that the project root is on `sys.path`.
Please don't commit on my behalf; I like to review the staged changes first.
Keep explanations brief.
Prefer readable code to clever code.
